outcomes.heading: Traditional support platforms help teams manage support. SwiftAgents helps teams reduce it.
outcomes.body: Most customer support platforms were built around tickets, dashboards, and workflows. SwiftAgents was built around outcomes.

whyTeams.heading: Why teams move beyond traditional support platforms
whyTeams.body: Whether you’re using Zendesk, Intercom, Freshworks, Tidio, or managing support manually, the challenge is the same: more customers create more conversations, and more conversations create more support work. SwiftAgents helps you reduce that workload before it reaches your team.
